$comment: Per-host settings for ix-cli/scripts/render-skills.mjs, which renders skills/workflows/*.md for each host below. dialect: how a skill reaches Ix (cli = shell commands with --format llm; mcp = the tools `ix mcp serve` registers). exposure: for an mcp host, the `ix mcp serve --tools` set the host registers; every tool its skills call must be in it, and the renderer refuses a core host's call to any other tool. Cursor is all because ix-cursor-plugin's mcp.json starts `ix mcp --tools=all` (a bare `ix mcp`, as `ix mcp install --host cursor` writes, is core). skills: the workflows the host ships. frontmatter: keys added to or overriding the template's front matter (null removes one). preamble: host-only lines that replace the template's {{preamble}} line (kept here, not in a template, because they link to files only the host plugin has).
